aboutSlogan: Translate, add to your dictionary, learn by having fun
aboutDescBody:
Wordistan is a modern, interactive word-learning platform designed to enhance your vocabulary and make the language learning process lasting.

It allows you to easily save and categorize the words you want to learn, and reinforce them with smart repetition methods. With its intuitive interface, real-time statistics tracking, and achievement badges, it transforms your word-learning journey into a motivating habit.
